builtBy: Read on 2026-11-06 from each school’s own athletics site or the page it links as its roster (readUrl), transformed by a script and checked against the page by hand: one entry per school whose site publishes a current-season JV field hockey roster.
notes: A school’s own JV list, transcribed as the school printed it: name, number, grade, position and height where the page gives them, null where it does not. Nothing is guessed. A name printed all in lower case or all in capitals is re-cased the way MaxPreps roster rows are (lib/sources/person-name.ts recaseName).

The team page shows the fuller of this list and MaxPreps’ JV roster (data/jv-rosters.json), each counted without the players on the varsity roster; the school’s own list on a tie (lib/jv/jv-rosters.ts).
Grades come from the page’s grade or class word, or from a graduating year (the class of 2030 are 2026-27’s freshmen). A captain is marked only where the page marks one.
Not refreshed by any scheduled job. Re-read by hand; checkedOn says when each list was read.
